name: hidx_tail_native_0854-tail0854-COMMIT
purpose: Actual existing4-key4-chunk FP32 pair-tree tail, native fixed16edges,16die replicas; exactgolden+operand-order/fault-mask/actual-clockdrop negatives. H-DIE provisional child only, parentclock/placement/whole-token proof OPEN.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hbm_idx_tail_native u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hbm_idx_owned_native.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_idx_arith_lat.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_idx_arith.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: tail_pair_mutant
bench.fail_regex: actual static tail data or fixed-timeline mismatch

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hidx_tail_native_0854/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hidx_tail_native_0854/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hidx_tail_native_0854 --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hbm_idx_tail_native  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
